original_ai_output.title_zh: 刚果（金）埃博拉应对人员遇袭，一名护士死亡、一名卫生工作者受伤
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 据世界卫生组织消息，在刚果（金）响应埃博拉疫情警报期间，一名护士遭袭击身亡，一名卫生工作者重伤。袭击发生在该国东部乔波省巴夫瓦森德镇。当局表示，针对卫生工作者和应急响应人员的一系列袭击正在阻碍遏制全球增长最快的埃博拉疫情的努力。

location.raw_text: town of Bafwasende in the country's eastern Tshopo province

key_facts.fact: 一名护士在响应埃博拉警报时遇袭身亡，一名卫生工作者重伤
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: A nurse was killed and a health worker severely injured after being attacked while responding to an Ebola alert in Congo, according to the World Health Organisation.

key_facts.fact: 袭击发生在刚果（金）东部乔波省巴夫瓦森德镇
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The attack took place Saturday in the town of Bafwasende in the country's eastern Tshopo province

key_facts.fact: 当局称针对卫生工作者的系列袭击正阻碍遏制埃博拉疫情的努力
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: It was the latest in a series of attacks on health workers and responders that authorities say is hampering efforts to slow the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in the world.

uncertainties: 事件目前仅有一个来源（Africanews）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
袭击者身份与动机尚未确认
